name: PdxSearchInput
description:
A search field with a search icon, a clear button and Escape to clear, that emits the search after
a debounce or on Enter.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: The input's placeholder. Empty: the search-input.placeholder component string, «Search...».

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name, submitted with the form.

members.name: debounce
members.description: Debounce delay in ms for pdx-search event (0 = no debounce)

members.name: shortcut
members.description: Keyboard shortcut hint displayed in suffix (e.g. "Ctrl+K")

members.name: size
members.description: xs, sm, md (the default), lg or xl — the same scale as pdx-input.

members.name: selectText
members.description: Select the whole text, so the next keystroke replaces it. Does not focus first.

events.name: pdx-search
events.description: The query, after the debounce or on Enter; not repeated for the same text.

events.name: pdx-clear
events.description: The clear button or Escape emptied the field, after its `value-change`.

events.name: value-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `value`. Does not bubble.
